design_defects_observed: The calibration projection describes its Stage 1 count as 144 z patches plus 24 v patches, but the frozen Stage 1 requirements also require one measured all-144-head joint z patch for E_all. The calibration is already labelled a lower bound; this additional omission makes its Stage-1 forward count one joint z forward too low. This run reports that forward separately and does not alter DESIGN.md.
